Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Interface AnimationAttribute

@CubismEditor public interface AnimationAttribute
One animated attribute on an AnimationTrack: an effect slot that carries a keyed value sequence.

    • setKeyframe

      default void setKeyframe(int frame, double value)
      Inserts or overwrites a scalar keyframe on a AnimationAttributeKind.FLOAT or AnimationAttributeKind.INTEGER attribute. The existing curve type is kept when the key already exists on a float attribute.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the value is not finite or the attribute is not scalar
      UnsupportedOperationException - when timeline writes lack exact verified host evidence

    • setKeyframe

      default void setKeyframe(int frame, double value, AnimationCurveType curveType)
      Inserts or overwrites a scalar keyframe with an explicit curve type on a AnimationAttributeKind.FLOAT attribute.

    • setKeyframe

      default void setKeyframe(int frame, float x, float y)
      Inserts or overwrites a keyframe on a AnimationAttributeKind.POINT attribute.

    • removeKeyframe

      default void removeKeyframe(int frame)
      Removes the keyframe at frame; absent keys are ignored.

    • offsetKeyframes

      default int offsetKeyframes(int frameDelta)
      Shifts every keyframe by frameDelta frames in one undo step. Curve types and stored bezier handles move with their keys. Returns the number of keys moved.

    • scaleKeyframeTimes

      default int scaleKeyframeTimes(double factor, int originFrame)
      Rescales every keyframe position around originFrame in one undo step: frame' = origin + round((frame - origin) * factor). Keys that collide on a target frame collapse in insertion order. Returns the number of source keys processed.

    • quantizeKeyframes

      default int quantizeKeyframes(int stepFrames)
      Rounds every keyframe position onto the stepFrames grid in one undo step. Colliding keys collapse in insertion order. Returns the number of source keys processed.

    • copyKeyframesFrom

      default int copyKeyframesFrom(AnimationAttribute source, boolean replace)
      Copies every keyframe (value, curve type, stored bezier handles) from source onto this attribute in one undo step. Both attributes must share the same AnimationAttributeKind. When replace is true the target's existing keys are removed first. Returns the number of keys copied.

    • applyCurveType

      default int applyCurveType(AnimationCurveType curveType)
      Applies curveType to every keyframe on this AnimationAttributeKind.FLOAT attribute in one undo step. Returns the number of keys retargeted.

    • applyCurveType

      default int applyCurveType(AnimationCurveType curveType, int fromFrame, int toFrame)
      Applies curveType to every keyframe whose frame lies inside [fromFrame, toFrame] in one undo step. Returns the number of keys retargeted.

    • recordKeyframe

      default void recordKeyframe(int frame, AnimationCurveType curveType)
      Writes a keyframe at frame holding the parameter's current evaluated value — recording-style input from preview adjustments. Only AnimationAttributeKind.FLOAT attributes joined to a model parameter can record.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when the attribute has no parameter binding or the scene has no live instance
      UnsupportedOperationException - when evaluated-value recording lacks exact verified host evidence

    • bakeEvaluated

      default int bakeEvaluated(int fromFrame, int toFrame, int stepFrames, AnimationCurveType curveType)
      Bakes the parameter's evaluated values into keyframes over [fromFrame, toFrame] stepping by stepFrames, in one undo step. Each step positions the scene instance at the frame, evaluates the track tree (physics and paramCtrl included), and writes the resulting parameter value. Returns the number of keys written.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the range is inverted or the step is not positive
      IllegalStateException - when the attribute has no parameter binding or the scene has no live instance
      UnsupportedOperationException - when evaluated baking lacks exact verified host evidence
